nervous_twitch.name: Nervous Twitch
nervous_twitch.desc: Stress +1 for you and for friendly PCs at short range.
tremble.name: Tremble
tremble.desc: −2 to skill rolls based on AGILITY until the panic stops.
drop_item.name: Drop Item
drop_item.desc: You drop a weapon or another important item; the GM picks which. Stress +1.
freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.desc: Rigid for one Round, the next slow action is lost. Stress +1 for you and for friendly PCs at short range.
seek_cover.name: Seek Cover
seek_cover.desc: Next action: get away from the danger to a safe spot. Your stress −1, friendly PCs at short range stress +1. Back to normal after one Round.
seek_cover.hint: Must use the next action to move away from the danger. A retreat roll is allowed if an enemy is at ENGAGED range.
scream.name: Scream
scream.desc: Screams for one Round, the next slow action is lost. Your stress −1; friendly characters who hear it make a Panic Roll at once.
flee.name: Flee
flee.desc: Flees to a safe place and stays there. Your stress −1; friendly characters who see it make a Panic Roll at once.
flee.hint: Flees and stays in the safe place: no attacks, nothing dangerous, no retreat roll.
berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: Attacks the nearest person or creature at once, friend or foe. Friendly characters who witness it make a Panic Roll at once.
berserk.hint: Attacks the nearest person or creature and only stops once they or the target is Broken.
catatonic.name: Catatonic
catatonic.desc: Collapses; can neither talk nor move.
catatonic.hint: Lies on the floor, does not talk, does not move.
phobia.name: Phobia
phobia.desc: Fear of something linked to the panic; the GM decides what.
phobia.hint: At short range of the phobia's object: stress +1. Close to it for more than one Round: Panic Roll.
alcoholism.name: Alcoholism
alcoholism.question: Did the character drink alcohol this Shift?
alcoholism.hint: Stress can only be relieved while drinking alcohol.
nightmares.name: Nightmares
nightmares.desc: EMPATHY roll when sleeping; on a nightmare stress +1 and no stress relief for a full day.
depression.name: Depression
depression.desc: Daily EMPATHY roll; on a failure stress +1 and no stress relief until the next day.
drug_use.name: Drug Use
drug_use.question: Did the character take their drug this Shift?
drug_use.hint: Stress can only be relieved with the character's drug.
amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.desc: No longer remembers who they or the others are.
sprained_ankle.name: Sprained Ankle
sprained_ankle.desc: MOBILITY −2 and no running until a MEDICAL AID roll succeeds.
crotch_hit.name: Crotch Hit
crotch_hit.desc: Every MOBILITY or CLOSE COMBAT roll costs 1 damage.
broken_ribs.name: Broken Ribs
ruptured_jugular.name: Ruptured Jugular
ruptured_jugular.desc: Fatal: Death Roll after one Round; MEDICAL AID to save it at −1. STAMINA −1.
freezing.name: Freezing
freezing.desc: No healing, no stress relief. STAMINA rolls depending on the cold; failure: 1 damage and stress +1. Ends once warm.
freezing.broken: Broken while Freezing: the next cold roll becomes a Death Roll.
the_long_haul.name: The Long Haul
the_long_haul.desc: Once per Act (Cinematic) or session (Campaign): ignore all facehuggers of one roll.

artificial_gravity_malfunction.name: Artificial Gravity Malfunction
artificial_gravity_malfunction.run_faile: MOBILITY roll failed. The book does not say what happens then; the GM decides.
coffee_maker_malfunction.name: Coffee Maker Malfunction
coffee_maker_malfunction.desc: The galley's coffee maker is out of order.
displacement_drive_malfunction.name: Displacement Drive Malfunction
displacement_drive_malfunction.desc: FTL rating changed; see ruling F-02.
intercoms_disabled.name: Intercoms Disabled
intercoms_disabled.hint: Talking only to people in the same area.
life_support_offline.name: Life Support Offline
life_support_offline.desc: Everyone aboard not wearing a vacuum-proof suit is Freezing and rolls STAMINA every Shift.

past_the_limit.name: Past the Limit
past_the_limit.desc: Push skill rolls based on STRENGTH twice; each push stress +1.
overkill.name: Overkill
overkill.desc: On a Panic Roll of 11 or more with enemies in sight, choose the Overkill effect instead.
authority.name: Authority
authority.desc: Use COMMAND instead of MANIPULATION to make someone give in.
cunning.name: Cunning
cunning.desc: Push skill rolls based on WITS twice; each push stress +1.
take_control.name: Take Control
take_control.desc: Roll MANIPULATION with WITS instead of EMPATHY.
nimble.name: Nimble
nimble.desc: Push skill rolls based on AGILITY twice; each push stress +1.
compassion.name: Compassion
compassion.desc: Push skill rolls based on EMPATHY twice; each push stress +1.
influence.name: Influence
influence.desc: Push skill rolls based on EMPATHY twice; each push stress +1.
reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Push skill rolls based on AGILITY twice; each push stress +1.
true_grit.name: True Grit
true_grit.desc: Push skill rolls based on STRENGTH twice; each push stress +1.
breakthrough.name: Breakthrough
breakthrough.desc: Once per session pass an OBSERVATION roll without rolling; the GM may forbid it.
inquisitive.name: Inquisitive
inquisitive.desc: Push skill rolls based on WITS twice; each push stress +1.
calm_breather.name: Calm Breather
calm_breather.desc: Air supply rolls use two dice fewer, at least one.
light_eater.name: Light Eater
light_eater.desc: Food supply rolls use two dice fewer, at least one.
menacing.name: Menacing
menacing.desc: When threatening, roll MANIPULATION with STRENGTH instead of EMPATHY. On a success the other side can ask for nothing in return but may attack.
stoic.name: Stoic
stoic.desc: Roll STAMINA with WITS instead of STRENGTH, also for the Death Roll (F-46).
overkill_effect.name: Overkill
overkill_effect.desc: Attacks the enemies at once until oneself or all enemies in sight are Broken. All other PCs at short range make a Panic Roll.
overkill_effect.hint: Attacks the enemies until oneself or all enemies in sight are Broken.
